title: Camcorder
description: A late-night record shop wall of Beatles sleeves seen through a 2000s camcorder viewfinder, with STBY, battery, date stamp and timecode on screen. Drag to aim and the hand-held picture lags, combs and hunts for focus; rock W–T to zoom into a cover until the digital zoom goes blocky, press Record, then play the clip back off the tape, where the picture locks in with a moment of tracking noise and a thin head-switching seam at the bottom edge.
intent: The imperfect home-video look of herb's references, made by the camera itself: auto-exposure that lags when you swing past the shop's spotlights, focus that hunts after a zoom, interlaced combing on fast pans, and a real record and playback loop, pointed at real album art.
